Chat Edit: 'How much income is required to make this viable, as it seems like my net wealth is decreasing? ======================================================================
2-YEAR ANALYSIS (Tax-free exit in NZ)
======================================================================

SCENARIO A: RENT + INVEST $200,000
  Rent paid: $62,400.00
  Deposit grows to: $220,500.00
  Investment gains: $20,500.00
  Net wealth: $158,100.00

SCENARIO B: BUY & SELL after 2 years
  Interest paid: $40,621.65
  Ownership costs: $33,778.84
  Property value: $663,062.50
  Capital gains: $38,062.50
  Loan remaining: $411,797.08
  Equity: $251,265.42
  Net wealth: $176,864.92

======================================================================
✓ BUYING is $18,764.92 better!

ROI on $200,000:
  Rent: -21.0% (-10.5% p.a.)
  Buy: -11.6% (-5.8% p.a.)'

Chat Edit: 'if I was earning 62.5k, then it would be just enough to cover the buy scenario, but I would have surplus income for the rent scenario, which I could invest? Recalculate where the same amount is invested regardless of scenario, and if rent then the difference is invested'
Chat Edit: 'ok there is an error, it is assumed that the difference between rent cost and income is invested, it should be between rent cost and buy cost'
